_description: Official confirmation timestamps for every blank (BGW) and double (DGW) gameweek in 2024-25 and 2025-26. Used by strategy_replay.py so chip decisions at GW k only see doubles/blanks officially confirmed before the GW k deadline; any unconfirmed future GW is treated as a normal single-fixture week (dgw=0, bgw=0).

2024-25.note: Merseyside derby postponed on the morning of GW15 due to Storm Darragh, before the 11:00 UTC GW15 deadline.
Rescheduled Merseyside derby placed in GW24 (12 Feb 2025); announced 13 Jan 2025 before GW21 deadline.
Aston Villa v Liverpool brought forward to GW25 after Liverpool reached the EFL Cup final on 6 Feb; confirmed 7 Feb 2025 before GW25 deadline.
EFL Cup final weekend blanks for finalists (LIV, NEW) and opponents (AVL, CRY); confirmed 7 Feb 2025 before GW25 deadline.
Newcastle v Crystal Palace rescheduled to GW32; announced 14 Feb 2025 before the 18:30 UTC GW25 deadline.
Post-FA Cup quarter-final rescheduling for semi-finalists and opponents; confirmed 3 Apr 2025 before GW31 deadline.
FA Cup semi-final weekend blanks confirmed alongside DGW33 on 3 Apr 2025 before GW31 deadline.

2025-26.note: Wolves v Arsenal brought forward to GW26 after Arsenal reached the EFL Cup final; confirmed 3 Feb 2026 before GW25 deadline.
EFL Cup final weekend blanks for finalists (ARS, MCI) and opponents (WOL, CRY); confirmed 4 Feb 2026 before GW25 deadline.
Post-FA Cup quarter-final doubles confirmed 5 Apr 2026 before GW32 deadline.
FA Cup semi-final weekend blanks confirmed alongside DGW33 on 5 Apr 2026 before GW32 deadline.
Man City v Crystal Palace rescheduled to GW36; confirmed 28 Apr 2026 before GW35 deadline.
